ns2:section.sectionText: Can NOT use this CRN (10538) to enroll in the course. Masters students: CRN for instructor will be provided to the student AFTER the required paperwork has been completed, signatures secured, and returned as instructed. For 599 form, go to http://webdocs.lis.illinois.edu/registration/599form.pdf . PhD students: inform the LIS Records office staff person of the faculty advisor you are registering with and the CRN for the faculty instructor will be provided.
